subject.title: WebChat: a config-change gateway restart drops the in-flight turn (empty/failed session, recovery can't resume, no user notice)

question: Should this issue be resolved by the linked scoped WebChat transcript-notice fallback, or should closure require broader restart deferral or immediate user-message persistence?
rationale: Current main still has the missing-notice path, but the issue lists multiple acceptable directions and the open fix only implements one of them.

options.title: Accept Scoped Notice Fix
options.body: Land the linked PR if normal review and validation pass, then close this issue as fixed while tracking stronger recovery behavior separately.

options.title: Require Request Preservation
options.body: Keep this issue open until the user message is durably persisted or resumed across the restart, not merely replaced by a resend notice.

options.title: Require Restart Deferral First
options.body: Make gateway restart deferral reliably wait for WebChat/agent work before accepting a notice-only fallback as sufficient.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Notice Fix
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR if normal review and validation pass, then close this issue as fixed while tracking stronger recovery behavior separately.

likelyOwner.reason: History ties this person to both delivery-mirror transcript behavior and gateway restart deferral, the two main solution shapes under consideration.
